desc:
Welcome to Wall Hop League Obby!

With 150 difficult stages!

The stages start off easy but progressively become much harder. Remember, this game is designed to be difficult, and as you play more, it will get even harder. Most players won't be able to finish it, so expect to encounter challenges along the way.

CONTROLS (Computer, Console):
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shift Lock (Shift, LT)
